summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception class. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test, non-node input tests, a cyclic-list ValueError test, and a graph-unchanged test. The 42 tests in test_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. mypy and black are not installed in that venv, so type-check and formatting were not run; the unreachable non-Node guard and the URIRef operator expressions in the test are the likely mypy risks. Nothing was committed and no other files changed.
